entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Any method named `Compare` is translated as the natural comparison of its arguments, so a comparer's own ordering is silently ignored (`StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`, custom `IComparer<T>`) #39402
  • Non-auto-loaded properties are not populated on entities even when explicitly selected by FromSql or LINQ projection #39398

PullRequests

Created

  • Introduce scoped DatabaseFacade.UseCommandTimeout #39403
    community-contribution
  • Use Path.Join for relative path composition in tools #39401
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39400
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39399
  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Use live version of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs #39350
    area-infrastructure

Updated

  • Use SYSDATETIME and SYSUTCDATETIME with datetime2 colums #39321
    community-contribution
  • Fix migrations alter column with referenced index filter #39323
    community-contribution
  • Compare converted reference-type identifiers by their provider values #39369
    community-contribution
  • Make parameter collection projections that cannot be materialized untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
  • Fix unbound parameter reporting for prefix-less and positional parameters #39371
    community-contribution
